description: This file defines a registry for invoke commands in the openclaw app, including command specifications, capabilities, and methods for querying available commands and capabilities based on runtime flags.

classes.name: NodeRuntimeFlags
classes.description: Data class representing runtime feature flags of a node, such as camera, location, SMS, call log, voice wake, motion, and debug build flags.

classes.name: InvokeCommandAvailability
classes.description: Enum defining the availability status of commands, e.g., always available or conditional based on features like camera or location.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityAvailability
classes.description: Enum specifying if a node capability is always available or depends on features like camera, location, SMS, etc.

classes.name: NodeCapabilitySpec
classes.description: Data class representing a node's capability with a name and its availability condition.

classes.name: InvokeCommandSpec
classes.description: Data class defining an invoke command's name, whether it requires foreground, and its availability condition.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieves an InvokeCommandSpec by command name.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a list of capability names that are advertised based on the current runtime flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of command names available given the current runtime flags.
